public.text: “Open technologies” is not defined. It may be interpreted as requiring open-source software, although open technology, open standards, source availability, open licensing, and vendor neutrality are separate considerations.
public.suggestedRevision: Define whether “open technologies” means open-source software, openly documented technology, royalty-free implementation, replaceability, or a combination. Avoid presenting open source alone as sufficient protection against lock-in.
